_doc: FP mode: a SEPARATE corpus (never mixed into the baseline STT_6 testset, like the RMW disjoint corpus). Same Alloy XML as the source testset; Stage 2 routes every consumed load's value through SSE registers. Forms (parsexml.py pass5_emit_llvm fpr_cfg.forms): route = GPR load then movq %out,%xmmK / movq $0,%out / movq %xmmK,%out; direct = SSE load movq mem,%xmmK (ldfp; exercises recon decode.cc isFloating-before-isLoad, audit R-SA-13); *_alu = adds pxor %xmmJ,%xmmJ; por %xmmK,%xmmJ (value-preserving SSE ALU op on the value) and copies back from xmmJ. Register names randomized per test (reg_naming random). Recipe and run config: runconfigs/fixed_20261030/STT_6_fp_stt_latest.jsonc; design wiki/design/VOCAB_TABLES.md 'FPR routing'.
